items.title: Rufus Reid interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, GA, January 4, 2013
items.q: William Paterson was the first to get the Doris Duke Award. And we had Benny Golson wrote for the orchestra... and we did a thing at Alice Tully Hall with the William Chamber Orchestra. And Marty was responsible for all of it... And he applied for it, and he got it.

ctx.x: Wow. I’ve been lucky to have a couple of those people too, so, I’m glad you got to speak about him.

Yeah. Because we all have to survive. We all have to — but when you can find someone who really — and I never knew what that word meant — someone who champions you. Someone who really champions you. He was the one that actually, because we were the first to get – William Paterson was the first to get the Doris Duke Award. And we had Benny Golson wrote for the orchestra, and he wrote a concerto for me, and he wrote pieces for himself, and we did a thing at Alice Tully Hall with the William Chamber Orchestra. And…
